note: Web searches for the 20 dossier zones of run-mars-002 (protocol mars-v3, section 5). Rule as in run-mars-001, fixed before reading the results: a match needs a source naming the place itself as an analog of the target environment, or describing its relief as the target's slope profile does at the MOLA scale; regional descriptions, analogs nearby or analogs of another environment give no match. A match is my judgement. The 14 ice-rich zones were searched for run-mars-001 and are reused. No finding was used to rank or remove a zone.

searches.place: Nye County, Nevada, United States
searches.query: Lunar Crater volcanic field Nye County Nevada Mars analog basalt plains
searches.finding: the Lunar Crater volcanic field (cinder cones, maars, alkali basalt flows; Apollo training and rover tests) is the named analog nearby, about 20 km north of the zone's northern edge (Lunar Crater near 38.38N, zone 38.03 to 38.18N); the zone itself is an alluvial basin floor between ranges (hillshade) with 98% of its geology samples not basalt; no source names this basin
